description.value: River Market Food Hall is a waterfront food court situated along the Fraser River at Westminster Quay in New Westminster, offering a mix of local eateries and vendors in both indoor and outdoor settings. A third-party blog describes the market as a 'vibrant waterfront marketplace' with diverse cuisine from Thai street food to smoked BBQ and gelato. The riverside location and no-smoking policy make it a pleasant potential refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the Lower Mainland.
